newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall as govt supplies rise.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall as govt supplies rise.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Wednesday despite anticipated seasonal demand and higher supplies, dealers said.

"Consumer demand was low despite approaching festivals while higher supplies led a further slide in the prices," one dealer said. Dealers said that the government had increased distribution of sugar through the public distribution network for forthcoming festivals which saw low sugar offtake in the open market. In ready delivery sugar S-30 slid by 5/6 rupees to 1,335/1,370 rupees while M-30 fell by seven at 1,370/1,425. Sugar mill delivery also fell to 1,260/1,280 from 1,270/1,285.
